Rashi on Sotah 2a:10:1.hebrew: עד כאן לא פליגי אלא בקינוי וסתירה - כלומר, עד כאן לא שמענו מפלוגתייהו דבעינן שני עדים אלא בקינוי לר"א, ובסתירה לר' יהושע:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:10:1.english: Until here they disagree only about warning and seclusion - That is, until here we have not heard from their dispute that two witnesses are required, except regarding the warning according to Rabbi Eliezer, and regarding the seclusion according to Rabbi Yehoshua.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:10:2.hebrew: אבל בטומאה - אם יש עדים בקינוי וסתירה, ויש עד אחד שקילקלה בסתירתה — נאמן, ואינה שותה, אלא יוצאה בלא כתובה, ואסורה לבעל ולבועל ולתרומה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:10:2.english: But regarding impurity - If there are witnesses to the warning and the seclusion, and there is one witness [who says] that she defiled herself during her seclusion, he is believed, and she does not drink [the bitter waters]; rather, she leaves [the marriage] without her ketubah, and she is forbidden to her husband, to the paramour, and to terumah.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:11:1.english: That she became impure - Through that same seclusion.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:12:1.hebrew: מנלן דמהימן עד אחד - בטומאה של סתירה אחר קינוי:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:12:1.english: From where do we derive that one witness is believed? - Regarding the impurity of seclusion [of the woman with the man] after the warning.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:12:2.hebrew: ועד אין בה בשנים הכתוב מדבר - וקאמר: עדים שנים אין בטומאה זו, אלא עד אחד. וקרא בטומאה קמישתעי: ״ושכב איש אותה שכבת זרע״, ״ועדים״ שנים אין בה אלא אחד, ״והיא לא נתפשה״ — לא נאנסה. וממילא שמעינן דמהימן, מדכתיב ״והיא לא נתפשה״: להחמיר עליה בא הכתוב, לדונה כמזידה. ומרישא דקרא נמי שמעת דמהימן, דקאמר ״ומעלה בו מעל ושכב איש אותה״, ואין מעיד בדבר אלא זה. ולקמן (סוטה דף ג.) מפרש דהאי קרא בתר קינוי כתיב, דכתיב בתריה ״ועבר עליו רוח קנאה״ וגו׳, ודרשינן ליה לקמן ״שכבר עבר״:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:12:2.english: "And there is no witness against her" – the verse is speaking of two [witnesses] - And it says: there are not two witnesses in this impurity, but only one witness. And the verse is speaking about this impurity: "And a man lies with her carnally"; yet "there is no witness" – meaning two witnesses – against her, but only one; "and she was not taken" – meaning she was not forced. And from this we learn by implication that [a single witness] is believed, from the fact that it is written "and she was not taken": the verse comes to be stringent with her, to judge her as one who acted willingly. And from the beginning of the verse as well you learn that he is believed, for it says "and commits a trespass against him, and a man lies with her," and no one testifies about this matter other than this [witness]. And later (Sotah 3a) [the Gemara] explains that this verse is written after the warning, since after it is written, "and a spirit of jealousy comes upon him," etc., and we expound it later as meaning "that it had already passed."

Rashi on Sotah 2a:13:1.hebrew: או אינו אלא אחד - דקאמר קרא דאפילו עד אחד אין בה. ולקמן פריך: אלא במאי מיתסרא? דקאמר קרא והיא לא נתפשה. אלמא פשיטא דנטמאת, מדמהדר בתר אונס ורצון:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:13:1.english: Or perhaps it is only one - For the verse says that even one witness is not against her. And later [the Gemara] asks: But by what means is she forbidden? For the verse says, "and she was not seized." Evidently it is taken for granted that she was defiled, since [the verse] seeks out [whether it was] coercion or consent.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:13:2.hebrew: ת"ל לא יקום עד א' וגו' - מהאי קרא שמעינן דכל עד האמור בתורה שנים הם, כדמפרש ואזיל:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:13:2.english: The verse states: "One witness shall not rise," etc. - From this verse we learn that every witness mentioned in the Torah is [meant to be] two, as [the Gemara] explains as it proceeds.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:1:1.hebrew: המקנא לאשתו - לישנא דקרא נקט: "וקנא את אשתו" (במדבר ה׳:י״ד). ולקמן בגמ' מפרש מאי לשון קינוי, ובמתניתין מפרש כיצד מקנא לה: אומר לה, "אל תסתרי עם איש פלוני":
Rashi on Sotah 2a:1:1.english: One who warns his wife - He used the language of the verse: "and he warns his wife" (Numbers 5:14). Later, in the Gemara, it explains what the term "warning" means, and in the Mishnah it explains how he warns her: he says to her, "Do not secrete yourself with so-and-so."

Rashi on Sotah 2a:1:2.hebrew: מקנא לה ע"פ שנים - אם בא להשקותה, צריך להביא שני עדים שאמר לה בפניהם: אל תסתרי עמו. ואם לא קינא לה בפני שנים, אינה נאסרת עליו בסתירתה, ואינו משקה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:1:2.english: He warns her on the basis of two [witnesses] - If he comes to make her drink, he must bring two witnesses [to testify] that he said to her in their presence, "Do not seclude yourself with him." But if he did not warn her before two [witnesses], she is not forbidden to him on account of her seclusion, and he does not make her drink.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:1:3.hebrew: ומשקה על פי עד אחד או על פי עצמו - ואפילו אין עדים שנסתרה, אלא עד אחד או הוא עצמו אומר "ראיתיה שנסתרה אחר שקינאתי לה", נאסרת בסתירה עד שתשתה. ולקמן ילפינן מקראי שסתירתה אוסרתה עליו מספק:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:1:3.english: And he gives her to drink on the basis of one witness or on the basis of himself - Even if there are no witnesses that she secluded herself, but only one witness, or he himself says, "I saw that she secluded herself after I warned her," she is forbidden [to him] by the seclusion until she drinks. And later (see Sotah 3a) we derive from the verses that her seclusion forbids her to him on account of doubt.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:1:4.english: Rabbi Yehoshua says - Two witnesses are required even for her seclusion [with the man]:

Rashi on Sotah 2a:2:1.english: And she spoke with him - Not in a secluded place.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:2:2.hebrew: עדיין מותרת לביתה - לשמש עם בעלה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:2:2.english: She is still permitted to her household - to have relations with her husband.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:2:3.english: And she is permitted to eat terumah - If she is the wife of a Kohen.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:3:1.english: Long enough for impurity - Long enough for [an act of] intercourse.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:3:2.hebrew: אסורה לביתה - מספק, כדילפינן לקמן (סוטה דף כח.): שלשה "ונטמאה" אמורים בפרשה — "וקנא את אשתו והיא נטמאה", "ונסתרה והיא נטמאה", "תחת אישה ונטמאה" — אחד שאסורה לבעל, ואחד שאסורה לבועל אם ימות בעלה או יגרשנה, ואחד שאסורה לתרומה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:3:2.english: Forbidden to her home - Due to doubt, as we derive below (Sotah 28a): Three [instances of] "and she became defiled" are stated in the passage — "and he is jealous of his wife, and she has become defiled," "and she was secluded, and she has become defiled," "under her husband and she became defiled" — one [teaches] that she is forbidden to her husband, one that she is forbidden to the paramour should her husband die or divorce her, and one that she is forbidden to [eat] teruma.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:3:3.hebrew: ואם מת - קודם שהשקה, ואין לו בנים, והיא זקוקה ליבם:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:3:3.english: And if he died - before he gave her to drink, and he has no children, and she is bound to the yavam [her late husband's brother, for levirate marriage].

Rashi on Sotah 2a:3:4.hebrew: חולצת - לינשא לשוק, ולא מתייבמת. ובגמרא יליף לה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:3:4.english: She performs chalitzah - [meaning she is thereby free] to marry an outsider, and she does not enter into levirate marriage. And in the Gemara, [the Gemara] derives this.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:4:1.hebrew: מכדי תנא מנזיר קא סליק - כן סדר המשנה: סוטה אחר נזיר:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:4:1.english: Since the Tanna has finished [the tractate of] Nazir - Such is the order of the Mishnah: Sotah [comes] after Nazir.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:4:2.hebrew: מאי תנא דתנא סוטה - מאי תנא בנזירות, דדמי לסוטה, דתנא סוטה בתרה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:4:2.english: What is the reason that the Tanna taught Sotah - What is the reason that the Tanna [taught] in [tractate] Nazir, which is similar to Sotah, that he taught Sotah after it?

Rashi on Sotah 2a:5:1.hebrew: בקלקולה - בניוולה ובבשתה, שמנוולין אותה כדקתני מתני' (לקמן סוטה דף ז:): קושר חבל למעלה מדדיה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:5:1.english: In her disgrace - In her degradation and shame, for they degrade her, as the Mishnah teaches (below, Sotah 7b): He ties a rope above her breasts.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:5:2.hebrew: יזיר עצמו מן היין - שהיין מביא לידי קלות ראש, והוא גרם לה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:5:2.english: He should separate himself from wine - For wine leads to light-headedness [i.e., frivolity], and he caused it [the wife's misconduct].

Rashi on Sotah 2a:6:1.hebrew: וליתני סוטה והדר נזיר - שכך היא סמיכת פרשתייהו:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:6:1.english: Let him teach Sotah, and then Nazir - For this is the order in which their passages are juxtaposed.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:6:2.hebrew: ותנא המדיר - פרק הוא בכתובות, "המדיר את אשתו". ואיידי דאיירי בנדרים, תנא נדרים אחר כתובות; ואיידי דתנא נדרים, תנא נזיר בתרה, שאף הנזירות באה על ידי נדר; והדר תנא סוטה בתרה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:6:2.english: And the Tanna [of our Mishnah] taught [the chapter] "One who prohibits [his wife by a vow]" - This is a chapter in [tractate] Ketubot, "One who prohibits his wife." And since it deals with vows, [the Tanna] taught [tractate] Nedarim after Ketubot; and since he taught Nedarim, he taught Nazir after it, for nazirite status too comes about through a vow; and then he taught Sotah after it.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:7:1.hebrew: לכתחילה לא - מדלא תני רבי אליעזר "אומר מקנא אדם לאשתו על פי שנים":
Rashi on Sotah 2a:7:1.english: Ab initio, no - Since [the Mishnah] did not teach, "Rabbi Eliezer says: A man warns his wife on the basis of two [witnesses]."

Rashi on Sotah 2a:7:2.hebrew: אסור לקנאות - שמביא עצמו לידי תגר, ואת אשתו לידי ניוול, ואפילו היא טהורה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:7:2.english: It is forbidden to warn - For he brings himself into a quarrel and his wife into disgrace, even if she is pure.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:1.hebrew: כי פתח - כשהיה בא לדרוש בפרשת סוטה:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:1.english: When he would begin - When he would come to expound on the passage of Sotah.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:2.hebrew: מזווגין אשה לפי מעשיו - צנועה לצדיק, ופרוצה לרשע:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:2.english: They match a woman according to his deeds - A modest one for the righteous man, and a promiscuous one for the wicked man.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:3.hebrew: כי לא ינוח שבט הרשע על גורל הצדיקים - לא יזדווג ממשלת רשע בגורל צדיק:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:3.english: For the rod of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous - The rule of wickedness will not be joined to the portion of a righteous person.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:5.english: To pair them - Those [matches] that are made according to his deeds.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:6.hebrew: כקריעת ים סוף - שנשתנו סדרי בראשית:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:6.english: Like the splitting of the Red Sea - For the order of creation was altered.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:7.hebrew: מושיב יחידים ביתה - אדם יחיד ואשה יחידה, והוא מזווגם יחד ומיישב מהם בית:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:7.english: He settles the solitary in a home - A single man and a single woman; and He pairs them together and establishes a household from them.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:8.hebrew: מוציא אסירים בכושרות - הוציא את ישראל ממצרים בחדש כשר, לא חמה ולא צינה. מקיש זיווג יחידים ליציאת מצרים:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:8:8.english: Who brings out the prisoners into prosperity - He took Israel out of Egypt in a suitable month, [when it was] neither hot nor cold. [The verse] likens the pairing of singles to the Exodus from Egypt.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:9:1.hebrew: איני - מי הוי זיווג לפי רשע וזכות? והא מקודם יצירתם, שאין נודע רשעו וזכותו, מכריזין את זוגו! ואם תאמר, הכל גלוי לפניו — הכל בידי שמים חוץ מיראת שמים, כדאמר במסכת נדה (דף טז:): מלאך הממונה על ההריון נוטל טיפה ומביאה לפני המקום, ואומר לפניו: טיפה זו מה תהא עליה? גבור או חלש, חכם או טיפש, עשיר או עני. אבל צדיק ורשע לא קאמר ליה, דאין זה בידי שמים:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:9:1.english: Is that so? - Is a match made according to wickedness and merit? But before their formation, when his wickedness and merit are not yet known, they proclaim his match! And if you say that everything is revealed before Him — everything is in the hands of Heaven except the fear of Heaven, as it says in tractate Niddah (16b): The angel appointed over conception takes a drop and brings it before the Omnipresent, and says before Him: "What will become of this drop? A strong person or a weak one, a wise person or a fool, a rich person or a poor one?" But he does not ask Him about a righteous person or a wicked one, for this is not in the hands of Heaven.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:9:2.english: The first pair - According to fate.

Rashi on Sotah 2a:9:3.hebrew: זוג שני - לפי מעשיו, וקשה לזווגן, לפי שאינה בת זוגו:
Rashi on Sotah 2a:9:3.english: A second match - [It is arranged] according to his deeds, and it is difficult to pair them, because she is not his [predestined] mate.

Tosafot on Sotah 2a:10:1.hebrew: אבל בטומאה עד אחד מהימן - תימה: אדרבה, איכא למימר איפכא! אבל בטומאה בעינן בי תרי, ומשום דאוסרתה איסור עולם. ואי לאו ממתני' דמייתי, מהיכא פשיטא ליה למימר הכי? וי"ל דעדיפא ליה טומאה מקינוי וסתירה, אף על גב דאוסרתה איסור עולם, משום דרגלים לדבר:
Tosafot on Sotah 2a:10:1.english: But regarding impurity, one witness is believed - This is surprising: on the contrary, one could say the opposite! [One could say:] But regarding impurity we require two witnesses, because it prohibits her [to her husband] with a permanent prohibition. And if not for the Mishnah that [the Gemara] cites, from where was it obvious to [the Gemara] to say this? And one can answer that [the Gemara] considers impurity to be stronger than warning and seclusion, even though it prohibits her with a permanent prohibition, because there are circumstantial grounds for the matter (*ragleyim la-davar*).

Tosafot on Sotah 2a:1:1.hebrew: המקנא. איידי דתנא נדרים תנא נמי נזיר דדמיא לנדרים - תימה: והא בריש מסכת נזיר (דף ב.) אמר דלא תנא ליה אלא אגב סוטה כדרבי? וי"ל דלא קבעה בסדר נשים אלא אגב סוטה, ומשום דדמיא לנדרים קבעה בתר נדרים, מ"ר. ותימה: אמאי לא קבעה אגב נדרים, דהא בפ"ד [דנזיר] תנא משניות טובא דמיירי בנדרי נשים ובהפרת בעל? ויש לומר דעדיפא ליה למימר משום סוטה, דפרשיות נמי נסמכו. ובריש מסכת שבועות (דף ב:) דייק נמי בכה"ג:
Tosafot on Sotah 2a:1:1.english: "The one who warns [his wife]" – Since [the Mishnah] taught [laws of] vows, it also taught [the laws of] a nazirite, which is similar to vows - This is puzzling: But at the beginning of tractate Nazir (2a) it says that [the Tanna] taught it only next to Sotah, in accordance with Rabbi [Yehudah HaNasi]! And one can answer that it was placed in the Order of Nashim only because of Sotah, and because it is similar to vows, it was placed after [the tractate on] vows; so [says] my teacher, the Rabbi. And it is puzzling: Why was it not placed on account of vows? For in the fourth chapter of [Nazir] it teaches many mishnayot that deal with the vows of women and with a husband's annulment [of them]. And one can say that he preferred to explain it on account of Sotah, because the Torah passages [of the two] are also juxtaposed. And at the beginning of tractate Shevuot (2b) it likewise draws a similar inference:

Tosafot on Sotah 2a:7:1.hebrew: המקנא דיעבד אין - וא"ת: וכי כל היכא דתני ה"א בתחילתן לשון דיעבד הוא? והא קתני בסוף אלו עוברין (פסחים דף מט.): "ההולך לשחוט את פסחו", ובעבודה זרה פרק השוכר (דף סט.): "המניח עובד כוכבים בחנותו", דמסיק בשמעתתא קמייתא דשחיטת חולין (דף ג.) דמיירי לכתחילה; ובפרק ב' דשחיטת חולין (דף לז.): "השוחט את המסוכנת"; ובפרק קמא דביצה (דף ו:): "השוחט את התרנגולת ומצא בה ביצים גמורות". ויש לומר דכל היכא דאיכא למיתלי בלישנא דייק הכי, כגון הכא, ובריש פ"ב דשחיטת חולין (דף כז.). והתם נמי בפ' קמא (דף טו:): "השוחט במגל יד", ובפ' קמא דביצה (דף ז:): "השוחט חיה ועוף יחפור בדקר", ובפ' חבית (שבת דף קמז.): "הרוחץ במי מערה או במי טבריא". ותימה: היכי דייק מהכא דאסור לקנאות? אמאי לא מתרץ "המקנא שבא", כדמתרץ בפ"ק דביצה (דף ז:)? ועל כרחך אית לן למימר דהכא ממשנה יתירא דייק, כדפרש"י:
Tosafot on Sotah 2a:7:1.english: "The one who warns" — after the fact, yes - And if you ask: Is it so that wherever [a mishnah] begins with the letter heh [the definite article "ha-"], it is language of after-the-fact? But it teaches at the end of [the chapter] "Eilu Overin" (Pesachim 49a): "One who goes to slaughter his Paschal offering," and in Avodah Zarah, chapter "HaSocher" (69a): "One who leaves a gentile in his shop," where [the Gemara] concludes in the first discussion of Chullin (3a) that it is speaking of [what is permitted] at the outset; and in the second chapter of Chullin (37a): "One who slaughters a dangerously ill animal"; and in the first chapter of Beitzah (6b): "One who slaughters a hen and finds fully formed eggs in it." And one can say that wherever there is room to hang [the inference] on the wording, [the Gemara] infers in this way, such as here, and at the beginning of the second chapter of Chullin (27a). And there too, in the first chapter (15b): "One who slaughters with a hand sickle," and in the first chapter of Beitzah (7b): "One who slaughters a beast or a bird should dig with a spade," and in the chapter "Chavit" (Shabbat 147a): "One who bathes in the water of a cave or in the water of Tiberias." And it is astonishing: How does it infer from here that it is forbidden to warn [at the outset]? Why does it not resolve [the wording] as "one who has come to warn," as it resolves in the first chapter of Beitzah (7b)? And we must say, despite this, that here it infers from the superfluous mishnah, as Rashi explained:

Tosafot on Sotah 2a:9:1.hebrew: קודם יצירת הולד - נראה לרבי: קודם יצירת הזכר, בין אם לא נולדה הנקיבה עדיין, בין אם נולדה:
Tosafot on Sotah 2a:9:1.english: Before the formation of the fetus - It appears to Rabbi [that this means] before the formation of the male, whether the female has not yet been born or whether she has already been born:

Tosafot on Sotah 2a:9:2.hebrew: הא בזוג ראשון הא בזוג שני - תימה: בפ' ואלו מגלחין (מו"ק דף יח:) דאמר שמואל: מותר לארס בחולו של מועד שמא יקדמנו אחר, קפריך ליה מהכא: ארבעים יום קודם יצירת הולד, אמאי לא מוקי התם מלתיה דשמואל בזוג שני:
Tosafot on Sotah 2a:9:2.english: This refers to the first pairing; that refers to the second pairing - This is puzzling: In the chapter of "Ve'elu Megalchin" (Moed Katan 18b), where Shmuel said, "It is permitted to betroth during the intermediate days of a festival, lest another man precede him," why does [the Gemara] challenge him from here — "Forty days before the formation of the embryo"? Why does it not explain Shmuel's statement there as referring to the second pairing?
